Elfin Twins GM-021 for GBA v1.2 completes link-cable multiplayer.

### What's new
- **Native GBA link multiplayer is fully implemented.** Connect two GBAs with a standard GBA Game Link Cable, leave both pets on the normal home screen, then open Link on one system. The other answers automatically.
- **All three linked games work:** tug-of-war, rock-paper-scissors and arm wrestling.
- The transport now uses the GBA's native 16-bit multiplayer SIO mode rather than the earlier GPIO experiment.
- Fixed the one-sided slow-motion/freeze that could happen during game selection when the calling GBA was also the hardware link master.
- Link behaviour is covered by host regressions and has been verified on **two real GBAs**.
- The manual and technical reference now document the corrected original-toy link protocol and the native GBA implementation.

### What to download
- **`elfin-twins.gba`** — the game.
- **`elfin-linktest.gba`** — the native link/RTC hardware tester.
- **Manual** and **technical reference** PDFs — updated for the finished multiplayer implementation.

### Before you play
Enable **SRAM saving** and the **real-time clock** for `elfin-twins.gba` in your flashcart menu. For multiplayer, use the same v1.2 ROM on both systems and a standard GBA link cable.

Thank you to azya52, whose [BrickEmuPy](https://github.com/azya52/BrickEmuPy) made this port possible, and to t.me/oksiniah for providing the original toy.
